items.summary: Add animated agricultural and horticultural visual elements to the HomePage hero section. Include CSS/Tailwind keyframe animations such as gently swaying wheat stalks or crops, floating leaves, growing plants, or soil particle effects rendered via SVG or canvas overlays to create a lush, nature-inspired atmosphere.

Add subtle animated decorative elements with an agricultural theme to the ProductCatalogPage and BusinessProfilePage — such as animated leaf dividers, sprouting plant borders, or drifting pollen particles — to reinforce the agro-horticulture brand identity throughout the site.

Enhance the Footer with a subtle animated agricultural/horticultural accent — such as a scrolling field row illustration, animated seedling icons, or a gently waving grass/crop strip — to unify the visual theme across the full page.

Define reusable Tailwind CSS keyframe animations (e.g., 'sway', 'float-up', 'leaf-drift', 'grow-in') in the Tailwind config to support all agricultural and horticultural animation effects across the site, ensuring consistent timing and easing.
